lines.zh: 我踏在雪面上不陷下去
lines.en: I walk on the snow without sinking.
My horns sweep the low branches.

lines.zh: 雪原的巢里，我踩过冰面。
lines.en: From my nest, I walk on ice.
Four hooves grip the ice firmly.
I head for that snowy wood.
I step over a drift of snow.
My breath comes out as white mist.
I trot along the ridge.
I run fast.
Snow sprays from under my hooves.
I go around a frozen tree.
I twist my head to look behind.
My prints in the snow are deep.
I head for somewhere colder.
I don't slip on the snow.
I stand in the snow, motionless.
Frost has formed on my horns.
I shake the snow off my back.
The snow in the nest is packed firm.
My breath keeps steaming.

lines.zh: 雪原的巢里，我踩着冰走。
lines.en: From my snowfield nest I walk on ice.
I don't feel the cold.
I bring my nose close to the snow.

lines.zh: 我在闻有没有别的东西
lines.en: I'm smelling for anything else.
I lift a forehoof, slowly.
And set it back down.
The wood is very still.
Snowflakes settle on my back.

lines.zh: 我低下头发出一声低鸣
lines.en: I lower my head and give a low cry.
Frost clings to my horns.
Who are you, and how did you get up here?
I raise my horns square at you.

lines.zh: 雪地里你的颜色很扎眼
lines.en: Your colors stand out in the snow.

lines.zh: 我踏着雪不陷，角扫开低枝。
lines.en: I cross the snow without sinking, horns sweeping low branches.
And stop to size you up.
Your boots are wrong for this snow.
My nest is right behind me.
Don't come any nearer to it.
I lower my head; white breath puffs out.
If you want to touch me, start at my neck.
Don't touch my horns.

lines.zh: 那是我用来打架的东西
lines.en: Those are what I fight with.

lines.zh: 雪原的巢里，外面的味道很重。
lines.en: From my snow nest, the outside smells strong.
The snow is deep; you can't move fast.
I'm much faster than you here.
Remember that.

lines.zh: 我能在水面上走，不用桥。
lines.en: I can walk on water without a bridge.
I walk the snow without sinking.
I'll wait until you move.
You've moved at last.
I recoil; the snow is churned.
That landed on my shoulder.
Blood on the snow, bright red.

lines.zh: 雪原的巢里，我卧着不动。
lines.en: In my snowfield nest I lie still.
I lower my horns to guard.
I retreat to the far side of the nest.

lines.zh: 雪地上多了几个深深蹄印
lines.en: Deep hoofprints appear in the snow.
I'm breathing hard.

lines.zh: 雪地上有我的血，很显眼。
lines.en: My blood on the snow is hard to miss.

lines.zh: 受伤的霜牦龙也会还手。
lines.en: Even a hurt frost yak strikes back.
Is that frozen meat?
I sniff. That smell I know.
Set it on the ground and I'll come.
I chew frozen meat all the same.
There's a bone stuck in it.
The frozen meat thaws a little in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你在旁边看着，我不介意
lines.en: You may watch. I don't mind.
Is there more?
That bite is very cold.
I know the taste of frozen meat.
Stand back, and I'll lower my head to eat.
A grease mark stays on the snow.
I chew slowly.
When I've finished, I come a little nearer.
I won't take your food for nothing.
What would you have me do?
There's little I can offer in return.
I turn aside to clear the snow path.
You hit my shoulder.
I step back; my prints go deep.
The snow takes half the impact.
I brush past your side.
My horn nearly caught you.
I turned my head away quickly.

lines.zh: 我脚下滑了一下，又站住。
lines.en: My feet slip, then find their grip.

lines.zh: 别站在我后面，雪道很窄。
lines.en: Do not stand behind me; the snow path is narrow.
I do kick.
My nest is in this snowy wood.

lines.zh: 你若要留下，得先被接受
lines.en: To stay, you'd have to be accepted.
I judge by deeds, not words.
Walk a way with me and see.
The snow's heavy. Keep close.
I'll wait, but not often.
If you're cold, come close.
There's warmth in me.
This wood has room for both.
Don't go before dawn.
I lower my head and take the meat.
I drag it into the nest.
I'll keep this for the winter.
Heavy; I carry it in my teeth.
Dropped in the snow, and lost.
I paw at the snow.
This one isn't fresh.
You dropped it? I'll pick it up.
I push it under a drift.
This will last me days.
I raise my head, horns that way.
I know this snow. It doesn't.
I walk toward it, slowly.
It's backing away.
The snow is slowing its feet.

lines.zh: 我的速度一点没受影响
lines.en: My speed is unaffected.
I stride the snow, faster and faster.

lines.zh: 我压低角，雪从背上滑落。
lines.en: I lower my horns; snow slides off my back.
My horn tips point forward.
Snow sprays from my hooves.
I run half a circle around it.
It's backed against a frozen tree.
Every step costs it effort.
I press in slowly.
My hoofbeats are muffled in the snow.
It has raised what it's holding.
That won't stop me.
I turn my head to avoid the front.
Two steps closer.
I charge.

lines.zh: 我前蹄刨雪，角尖挑过去。
lines.en: I paw the snow and sweep my horns up.
It staggers backward.
I wheel away at once.
My hooves kick out.

lines.zh: 我蹄子踩在水面上，不会沉。
lines.en: My hooves rest on water without sinking.
It hasn't come closer.
I look back at my nest.
It's untouched.
I stand where I am.
And wait for it to go.
I rise out of a snowdrift.
Snow slides off my back.
This is my nest.
Snow and frozen trees all around.
I lift a hoof and set it firm.
Wind chills my horns.

lines.zh: 我从雪堆里站起来，雪从背上滑落。
lines.en: I rise from the snow and it slides off my back.

lines.zh: 我沿着巢的边缘走了一圈
lines.en: I walk once around the nest's rim.
There are no other tracks in the snow.

lines.zh: 巢里的雪被我的呼吸吹化。
lines.en: My breath melts the snow in the nest.
I walk a few steps into the trees.
And look back at the nest.

lines.zh: 雪化了一片，我也被烫到
lines.en: Snow melts away, and I'm burned too.

lines.zh: 我从冰坡上滑下去，摔得很重
lines.en: I slide down the ice slope and land hard.
Icy water floods my nose.
Snow bursts into the air.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的后腿，雪窝太滑。
lines.en: An arrow in my hind leg; the snow nest is slick.
This heat sears my horns.
The frozen meat is gone; I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在雪原上，我浑身一僵
lines.en: Lightning hits the snowfield; I lock up.
The snowfield splits and I fall.
